confirmed_fact: Planning to park in a residents' permit zone during restricted hours needs a permit. The online application needs proof of address and vehicle ownership a smartphone photograph will do a student reference number if applicable and payment by a credit or debit card registered for 3D Secure.
source_name: Apply for renew or cancel a parking permit
caveat: The page does not state every permit price.

confirmed_fact: Before applying check you are eligible by reading the permit eligibility guidance and check which zone your property is eligible for. Not all properties within a resident parking zone are eligible for a parking permit.
source_name: Apply for a new residents permit
caveat: Eligibility depends on the property register.

confirmed_fact: The applicant must reside in a property specified in the Permit Entitlement Register as eligible for a Residents Permit and within the Residents Parking Zone and must own the vehicle.
source_name: Residents Parking Permit Charges Amendment Order 2026
caveat: The order sets charges and conditions; check the current order.

confirmed_fact: Single Person Discount of 25 percent applies when only one person aged 18 or over lives in the property.
caveat: Certain people are disregarded when counting adults.

confirmed_fact: Certain full time students student nurses apprentices and youth training trainees some non British spouses and dependants of students patients living in hospital or care homes and people who are severely mentally impaired may be disregarded for Council Tax.
caveat: The page lists the full rules.

confirmed_fact: Council Tax Reduction may be available if you have a low income or are in receipt of benefits. The council also lists student and other discounts and exemptions.
source_name: List of Council Tax discounts and exemptions
caveat: Entitlement depends on the full application.

confirmed_fact: To see bin collection days enter a postcode or street name of at least six characters then select your address and wait for the calendar. Garden waste collections only display if you have subscribed.
caveat: This is a page search not an address API.
